words: with also an feedback lane that will reach you
context: Said with Dinis's ask for a better design of the Now list and a live HTML deck on decisions.agents.sovereignweb.site.
decision: feedback.b adds a feedback lane for decisions.agents.sovereignweb.site (decisions-agents, in its vault), with a QR code on /asks/ and /deck/, and relays each message to decisions.b's session by message, as material.
